Class TotemPickingScreen

All Implemented Interfaces:
EventVisitor<GUIScreen>
public class TotemPickingScreen extends GUIScreen
GUI screen for the totem-picking phase. Displays totem images in a row; greyed-out totems are already taken. The player clicks (or presses SPACE) to select and confirms with the button or ENTER key. Updates on TotemAvailableEvent.
